title: Aeroplane Chess Ludo
description: Roll the dice, launch your colorful fleet out of the hangar, ride shortcut flight lanes, bump rivals back to base, and race all four planes home.
controls: Tap the dice to roll, then tap any highlighted airplane token to move it along the colorful board track.

zh-CN.title: 经典飞行棋
zh-CN.description: 国民童年回忆经典飞行棋：摇出 6 点霸气起飞，踩同色格子连跳捷径、撞飞对手棋子，率先全机抵达终点夺冠！
zh-CN.controls: 点击骰子投掷点数，再点击可移动的飞机棋子沿赛道前进、撞击对手并冲向终点。
